mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1 < 13200) and housing starts (HOUST < 600) indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 < 13200 and HOUST < 600.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210) combined with elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) triggers aggressive monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and generating negative 20-day returns.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 350,000 indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 350,000.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% triggers immediate market volatility from aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS < 130000) and industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate output and profit growth, causing negative 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 130000 and INDPRO < 100.
